rows.name: Amorphous
rows.description: 1/day take form of viscous liquid

rows.name: Burdenless
rows.description: Carrying capacity increased by 50%

rows.name: Calming
rows.description: 10 rounds/day create 5' aura that supresses rage or emotion effects (DC 15 Will negates)

rows.name: Jarring
rows.description: 3/day daze attacker for 1 round (DC 16 Fortitude negates)

rows.name: Restful
rows.description: Only need 2 hours of uninterrupted sleep, and heals as in comfortable bed; not fatigued by sleeping in this armor

rows.name: Sensing
rows.description: Gain 5-foot blindsight and 60-foot darksense when wearer can't see

rows.name: Spell_Dodging
rows.description: +4 dodge AC against attack rolls from spells, spell-like abilities, and attacks of summoned creatures

rows.name: Spiteful
rows.description: If wearer has panache class feature, can spend 1 panache point to make melee attack aginst creature that reduced wearer to below 0 hp

rows.name: Trackless
rows.description: +5 on Stealth; Survival checks to track wearer take -5 penalty

rows.name: Vouchsafing
rows.description: Gain stacking DR 5/- when unconscious, nauseated, stunned, or pinned

rows.name: Answering
rows.description: Enhancement bonus increases by 4 (to a max of 5) for the purpose of the opportune parry and riposte deed

rows.name: BloodHunting
rows.description: +2 enhancement, +2d6 damage against foe with bloodline

rows.name: Bloodsong
rows.description: weapon gains keen ability when wielder benefits from raging song; gain 1d10 temporary hit points if wearer confirms critical while under raging song (2d10 if crit multiplier is x3, 3d10 if crit multiplier is x4)

rows.name: Brawling
rows.description: wielder gains enhancement bonus on combat maneuver checks equal to the enhancement bonus of the weapon

rows.name: Confounding
rows.description: wielder can spend 1 panache point when confirming critical to attempt disarm, reposition, sunder, or trip, as an immediate action with no attack of opportunity provoked, with a enhancement bonus equal to the weapon's enhancement bonus

rows.name: Distracting
rows.description: increase target's concentration DC by 5 for 1 minute; can't be affected again for 24 hours

rows.name: Distracting_Greater
rows.description: increase target's concentration DC by 10 for 1 minute; can't be affected again for 24 hours

rows.name: Exclusionary
rows.description: can choose not to include target in channel ability for next minute; maximum of Wisdom bonus plus enhancement bonus exclusions

rows.name: Exhausting
rows.description: on critical hit, wielder can forgo additional damage to cause exhaustion

rows.name: FateStealing
rows.description: steal 1 grit or panache point from target as swift action

rows.name: Flamboyant
rows.description: has 1 panache point

rows.name: Flamboyant_Greater
rows.description: has 3 panache points

rows.name: Flying
rows.description: as dancing but 30 ft. away; weapon returns to wielder as swift action (500 ft./rd), attempts sunder to return if needed

rows.name: Fortuitous
rows.description: if first attack of opportunity hits, can make second at -5 penalty

rows.name: Inspired
rows.description: investigator need only spend one use of inspiration to augment attack rolls; add twice result to damage with combat inspiration talent

rows.name: Phantom_Ammunition
rows.description: ammunition dissolves and wound closes 1 round after fired

rows.name: Prehensile
rows.description: as swift action, whip can be used as grappling hook; spend 1 panache to increase reach to 20 ft. for 1 attack, and can use the whip with precise strike

rows.name: Sacred
rows.description: acts as holy symbol; if wielder has blessings class feature, when channeling energy can choose one ally or ally's weapon within the area to get one of his minor blessings at a cost of one use of that blessing

rows.name: Sneaky
rows.description: 1/day designate foe as prey: get sneak attack damage on next attack; use 2/day if user is rogue or slayer with hunter's surprise talent

rows.name: SpiritHunting
rows.description: +2 enhancement, +2d6 damage against foe with mystery or spirit
